name: TextInput
description: The TextInput component provides an accessible text input field with support for labels, helper text, validation, and error states. Controlled (value) or uncontrolled (defaultValue).
usage: Controlled with `value` and the native `onChange(event)`, or uncontrolled with `defaultValue` (onChange still fires)
An `error` the app passes shows at once; pass `touched` (the field's touched state) to hold it until the field is left. `touched={false}` hides it
The `validate` message shows after the field's first blur, or at once when `touched` is true
An external `error` wins over the `validate` message
Helper text provides additional context and is hidden when an error is shown; while disabled, the helper shows instead of the error
`id` and `label` are optional: the id is generated, and without a visible label pass `aria-label`
Mark required fields with the required prop for both visual and semantic indication
Sizes: '2xs' | 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' (default) | 'lg'; compact is the deprecated alias for 'xs'
design: Labels use `.type-label` (14px medium) for consistent form styling.
Helper text uses `.type-caption` which includes muted color semantically.
Error messages use `.type-body-sm` (14px) with error color override.

Size xs (and its deprecated alias compact) uses h-7 (28px) height, smaller typography: `.type-label-sm` (12px) for labels, `.type-caption` for errors, `.type-caption-compact` (10px) for helper text. Aligns with Button size='xs'.
Number inputs have custom styled increment/decrement buttons with ChevronUp/ChevronDown icons, replacing native browser spinners for consistent cross-browser appearance.
One border colour per state: --color-border-subtle at rest, --color-error with an error, --color-border-emphasis while disabled
accessibility: Labels are properly associated with inputs using the for/id relationship
Error states are communicated to assistive technology via aria-invalid and aria-describedby
Helper text is linked to the input using aria-describedby
Required fields are marked both visually and with the required attribute
Number input spinner buttons have aria-labels and are removed from tab order (tabIndex=-1) to preserve native keyboard navigation
Focus shows on any focus (focus:ring-1 primary; error: --color-error), as for every text field

props.name: id
props.description: The input's id; generated with useId() when left out

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label (a <label for>). Without it, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the label visually; screen readers still read it as the field's name. For a field whose purpose the layout already shows.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled: the field's text. Leave out for uncontrolled

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled: the text at first

props.name: onChange
props.description: The native change event, in both modes

props.name: type
props.description: Standard HTML input type

props.name: error
props.description: External error message (e.g. from server validation); shown at once unless touched is false or the field is disabled. Wins over the validate message. Sets aria-invalid and aria-describedby

props.name: validate
props.description: Returns an error message string if invalid, null or undefined if valid. Its message shows after the first blur, or at once when touched is true

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text displayed below the input (not shown when an error is displayed)

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root (merged with cn)

props.name: inputClassName
props.description: Classes for the input (merged with cn; the app's class wins a conflict)

props.name: touched
props.description: Leave out to show error at once (and validate's after the first blur); pass the field's touched state to hold both until the field is left (false hides them)

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the input loses focus (the field also notes its own first blur for validate)

props.name: required
props.description: Indicates if the field is required (adds visual marker and native attribute)

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input field

props.name: size
props.description: Height, padding and type from the input size scale (utils/inputSizing)

props.name: compact
props.description: Deprecated: use size="xs". size wins when both are given

props.name: ref
props.description: The native input

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Every other prop (name, aria-*, data-*, onKeyDown, onFocus, placeholder, autoComplete, min/max/step…) goes to the input; an aria-describedby is kept beside the helper or error id
